watch_list.summary: Lauren posted a new /reframe skill in pstack for when you know what you want but can’t quite say it, and says it works well with /sharpen.

watch_list.short_title: Add to chat from a bot reply
watch_list.summary: She confirmed Grok Bot’s “Add to chat” feature, copied from Cursor: select any part of a bot reply, then press Ctrl+L or hover to add it back into the chat.
Lauren says she’s now daily-driving Gemini Neon in Cursor and calls it a good model.
Asked whether she uses Neon as orchestrator or executor, she said she’s using it for both, with Opus as the reviewer.

watch_list.short_title: Build and share Mac and Windows apps with Claude
watch_list.summary: Felix announced you can now build and share Mac and Windows apps with Claude, no coding required; they can use OS APIs, connectors, and Claude, and he posted demos at https://claude.ai/artifact/9j53nCVcrSdZyCHtxUZkWJ.

watch_list.short_title: Native desktop apps he’s already building
watch_list.summary: He’s been using it to make his own terminals, file managers, video editors, comms tools, and desktop pets, including native features like menu-bar items, transparent windows, and notifications; update Claude for macOS and Windows to try it.
To try the little-apps feature, he suggests asking Claude to “Build me a desktop pet as an artifact app,” and shared a Nori Desktop Shark demo at https://claude.ai/artifact/75cGBx19aZZXjWdbqUhmy1.

items.title: Rent NVIDIA GPUs From a Chat | Higgsfield GPU Harness
items.summary: Connect Higgsfield to Claude, type /gpu, and GPU Harness rents the right NVIDIA GPU from chat — including hardware like the B300 you couldn’t just buy — so you can train a LoRA or have Claude build and render a Blender scene in the cloud.

items.title: How To Make AI Animation That Doesn't Look Generic (Full Breakdown)
items.summary: Kixwood breaks down one scene from their upcoming short Below the Surface: design characters in SOUL 2.0, paint over them by hand, build the shot in Seedance 2.5, then replace stiff AI voices with ElevenLabs before the 1080p render.

items.title: 黃仁勳回任，這世界真是太瘋了｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: Kelly reacts to news that Jensen Huang is back in the NVIDIA post, after the earlier resignation-scandal coverage.

items.title: 黃仁勳帶來的股價不確定性，該怎麼看待？｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: A course short (recorded 10 Nov) on how to view NVIDIA-related stock uncertainty, arguing a risk-management system matters more than predicting the headlines, and pointing to a session with guest 美股航海王.

items.title: Meta Muse 新手教學，社群功能最強的 AI Agent
items.summary: A beginner walkthrough of Meta’s free Muse agent: VPN signup, invite-code tokens, an interface tour, connecting Instagram, Threads, and Facebook for saves and auto-replies, plus how it compares with Grok Bot and Claude Code.
